snippet.title: Cellscape is an upcoming game that lets you play as a microbe
snippet.description:
Experience life as a microbe in a dynamic, living ecosystem. Hunt bacteria, dodge hazards and predators, and divide as many times as you can.

Cellscape is coming to early access on Steam in 2026. Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3650410/Cellscape/
